text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mihono 
Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, do you remember our previous 
session of creating 'Precious Memories'?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Operation failed. Only 
Master's fatigue has accumulated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would like to seek Master's 
instructions next.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With just me, the number of patterns is 
limited, and I judge that we will not 
obtain meaningful results.

"I had intended to make a proposal from my 
side from the beginning, butâ"

...Come to think of it, I've heard that 
Mihono Bourbon has a high chance of 
breaking machinery whenever she touches 
it.

"If we can touch them without breaking 
them, wouldn't that become a 'precious 
memory' of something we overcame 
together?"
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should do some special training so 
I can handle machines...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In a machine... Does that really become a 
"precious memory"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I still do not fully comprehend what 
qualifies as a 'precious memory,' but if 
it is Master's order, I shall proceed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I look forward to serving you, Master.

Later on, I immediately began Mihono 
Bourbon's special training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An electric kettle that can only heat 
water to lukewarm, a television monitor 
with a cracked screen, a fan that only 
spins sluggishly...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Master. If it is meant to be 
disposed of, I can touch it without 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Objective set: "Touch equipment without 
breaking it."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well then— commencing operation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The electric kettle—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Catastrophic damage, total shutdown 
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: On the monitor—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Catastrophic damage, total shutdown 
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Electric fan—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Catastrophic damage, total shutdown 
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A calculator, a blender, a gaming console—

I touched each of them one after another. 
It seemed that every single one had broken 
the moment it was powered on.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Lives left: 1... My last smartphone—

—And at the end of Mihono Bourbon's 
outstretched hand was—

"...That's my work phone! I carelessly 
left it right next to the special training 
equipment...!"

"...That's my work phone! I carelessly 
left it right next to the special training 
equipment...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Smartphone identified as Master's 
personal property. Suspending training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, there are no more machines to 
test. Does this conclude the training?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Too bad.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, my status is 'disappointing.' I 
judge that this is how it should be, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No. More importantly, Master, you have 
a smudge on your cheek.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It appears she got dirty while cleaning up 
the wrecked equipment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"All the equipment broke, so the objective 
'touch the equipment without breaking it' 
ended in failure, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Due to Master's actions, a piece of 
significant data has been detected in 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So... next time will surely be fine.

Without saying another word, Mihono 
Bourbon simply wiped the dirt off my cheek 
in silence.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirming instructions. Touching 
carefully—... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, does that smartphone belong to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I noticed too late and my 
fingertip brushed against it. Could you 
please check if it is functioning 
properly?

I pick it up gently. The power should have 
been left on, but the screen remains 
black.

...It seems the power won't turn on 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I assess this will hinder Master's work. 
Please conduct repairs immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm truly, terribly sorry.

When I comforted her by saying we could 
have stopped it if we really wanted to, 
Mihono Bourbon just stared intently back 
at me.

text_block_list.text:

a smudge on your cheek.

the wrecked equipment.
